mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_attachment a JOIN question q ON q.current_revision_id=a.revision_id WHERE a.file_id=#{fileId} AND q.id IN (SELECT id FROM active_question) AND q.bank_id IN (SELECT id FROM visible_question_bank))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_attachment a JOIN practice_item i ON i.revision_id=a.revision_id OR i.material_revision_id=a.revision_id JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=i.session_id WHERE a.file_id=#{fileId} AND s.user_id=#{userId})
